images.prompt: A cinematic, high-contrast scene of a glowing AI brain model suspended in a dark server room, with digital screens showing lines of code and a faint red ALERT light. images.prompt: An infographic style diagram illustrating the AI supply chain attack flow: from left, a compromised developer environment (laptop with cracked screen icon) to uploading a malicious model (Trojan horse icon) to Hugging Face hub (icon of repository), then download arrows to various users (laptop icons). Dark theme with red highlighted attack path, blue safe path. Typography: 'Compromise', 'Inject', 'Upload', 'Distribute'. Clean lines and icons.
images.altText: Infographic of the AI model supply chain attack flow
images.caption: Figure 1: Attack flow diagram.
